title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and use face masks over time in response to social influence, perceived risk, policies, enforcement, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update mask attitudes and usage probability based on neighbors' observed behaviors and expressed opinions.

interactions.name: household_influence_and_sharing
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's attitudes and share mask inventory.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations enforce mandates via checks, warnings, and fines; individuals may comply, avoid, or be denied entry.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to price, stock, and rationing constraints.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: Individuals receive messages from media channels that shift risk perception and attitudes.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast_and_updates
interactions.description: Government authorities announce mandates, adjust fines, and run campaigns affecting compliance and perceived norms.

interactions.name: risk_feedback_from_epidemic
interactions.description: Prevalence and trend information affects perceived risk and mask usage decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step (and/or averaged over the simulation period).

metrics.name: context_specific_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Mask usage rates by location type (e.g., workplace, retail, transport).

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Share of days retailers experience zero stock in at least one region.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of warnings/fines issued due to non-compliance.

metrics.name: average_masks_purchased_per_capita
metrics.description: Mean number of masks purchased per person over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption_index
metrics.description: Inequality in mask usage across income quintiles (e.g., Gini or percentile gap).

metrics.name: estimated_transmission_reduction
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in transmission potential derived from mask usage and efficacy (model-based proxy).
